author: Jasmine Bell
text: We had an issue with our plumbing and called Fletcher Plumbing & Heating. They were very responsive and sent Josh J. to our home to help. He was fantastic from start to finish. His customer service was outstanding, he was thorough in explaining everything, and he truly went above and beyond to make sure the issue was taken care of. We really appreciated his professionalism, attention to detail, and willingness to help. Highly recommend!

author: Evan Warner
text: Called Fletcher in the morning with a sewer line back up and left a VM. Dave called me back within minutes and said they'd get a tech on the job ASAP. Got a call 1.5 hours later from Josh saying he could be out in the next 30 minutes. Gave him the go ahead and he was very prompt and punctual. He worked diligently and quickly and got the line cleared, with a thorough explanation of the problem. All for a reasonable price.

author: Meghan Quinn
text: I've been dealing with shower drain issues for years. We've had several plumbers out that either couldn't help or fixed it for a week and the issue came back. Fletcher's responded same day, fixed the issue quickly, and were super affordable. Wish I called them years ago! 10/10 recommend!

author: Michelle Sears
text: Sean came within 30 minutes of me calling. He was friendly and professional.  He was able to rectify our problem in a timely manner. We truly appreciate his prompt and professional service on a Sunday!

author: Brittany Budreau
text: The staff were very friendly and took care of me as soon as they could on short notice. I appreciated the updates while I waited for an available plumber. The plumber was knowledgeable and friendly and took care of my clogged toilet. Will always call them first in the future
